text:
elaine (Docs): Heads-up team, I opened a new draft for the upcoming relnotes (0.9.8-gamma): https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4321. Main priorities: tighten the feature bullets, make the known-issues precise, and verify the streaming embed SDK snippets.

mike r: Got it. Which snippet do you want me to focus on first: JS streaming or Go embed client?

elaine (Docs): Start with the JS streaming example — model response shape changed and the example assumes old behavior. Also we added a short migration blurb for moving from /embeds -> /embed-streaming; needs PM-friendly wording.

jasmin: I can write the migration blurb. Proposal: a concise TL;DR + tiny HTTP before/after example. Keep it ~3 lines and link to the full migration doc.

samir: On the PR now. Current docs/examples/embed-stream.md includes:```js
const resp = await client.embeddings.stream({ model: "rwd-embed-lite", input: ["a", "b"] });
for await (const chunk of resp) {
  // handle chunk
}
```
But the server now emits an initial metadata object, so snippet must show skipping metadata or branching on chunk.type. Otherwise readers will be confused.

olivia: Suggest adding a one-line guard: `if (chunk.type === 'meta') continue;` with a comment about the metadata header.

mike r: I'll push that edit. Also flagged a feature bullet that says "batch caching reduces per-token costs by up to 4x" 0 we should remove the absolute claim per Legal. Change to "can reduce per-token costs in some latency-tolerant workloads; see benchmark."

elaine (Docs): Agreed. Update to: "can reduce per-token costs in latency-tolerant workloads; see benchmark." Add the public benchmark link inline.

docs-bot: PR 4321 updated: +3 commits, reviewers requested: jasmin, mike r.

jasmin: About known issues 0 we currently list "embed-streaming may drop first token under heavy load." Is that still the right phrasing?

samir: We patched the race last week. It's now limited to very long inputs (>64k) combined with extreme concurrency. Recommend: "Edge-case: very long inputs (>64k) under peak concurrency may miss early tokens; workaround: enable prefix-caching or upgrade runtime."

elaine (Docs): Nice. Also PM asked to soften the What's New line. Replace "introduces prefix/KV caching and quantization-friendly kernels" with "introduces smarter request caching and model optimizations to lower cost and latency."

olivia: I'll update the blurb and mark it PM-approved in the PR.

mike r: Found two micro issues: 1) changelog anchor points to /docs/api#embeddings (broken) -> should be /docs/api/embeddings. 2) Go snippet calls `client.Embeds(...)` which is deprecated; rename to `client.Embeddings.Create(...)`.

elaine (Docs): Good catches. Please use explicit commit messages so the release pipeline picks up the fixes: "fix: correct embeddings anchor" and "fix: go sdk method rename".

jasmin: Drafting the migration TL;DR: "If you're calling /embeds, switch to /embed-streaming for live results. Most clients will only need a small change to the request path; no model changes required. See migration guide for code examples and compatibility table."

elaine (Docs): Tiny edits: change "small" -> "minimal" and add "No code changes required for model parameters."

jasmin: Updated: "If you're calling /embeds, switch to /embed-streaming for live results. Most clients will only need a minimal change to the request path; no code changes to model parameters required. See the migration guide for code examples and a compatibility table."

samir: I'll export the compatibility matrix from the infra tool and attach a CSV to the guide. Note: older quantized variants may not support streaming; I'll add a short compatibility note.

olivia: Running linkcheck on the PR branch now, will report any stale links.

docs-bot: linkcheck: starting on pr/4321...

mike r: Pushed snippet updates, go rename, anchor fix, and blurb edits to the branch.

docs-bot: linkcheck: completed. 2 broken links detected.

olivia: The broken links: 1) internal S3 link for benchmark results (needs public URL), 2) trailing-redirect for /docs/api/embeddings still causes a 301. I'll replace with the canonical public benchmark doc and update the anchor.

elaine (Docs): After those fixes, can we aim to merge by EOD? I want the relnotes live with the platform patch tomorrow morning.

jasmin: I'll approve once the migration TL;DR and CSV link are present.

samir: CSV uploaded as artifacts/compatibility-matrix.csv on the PR. Also added the note about quantized variants.

docs-bot: PR 4321: reviewers approved: jasmin, mike r. Ready to merge.

mike r: Merged the branch. :tada:

elaine (Docs): Thanks all I'll schedule the release-note publish job for 08:00 UTC tomorrow and monitor rendering. Bullet indentation sometimes renders oddly; keep an eye.

olivia: I'll watch the page post-publish and fix any layout issues.

mike r: I'll follow up with a small PR that adds a rendered screenshot of the JS streaming snippet so readers get the expected output.

elaine (Docs): Final action summary: jasmin: migration blurb (done), mike r: snippet + go rename (done), olivia: link fixes + linkcheck (done), samir: compat CSV (done). I'll post the publish job ID to #release-war-room after scheduling.

samir: Great work, team.

elaine (Docs): :heart:
